settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: School profile, academic rules, appearance and security
settings.logoHint: Used on receipts, report cards and printed lists (PNG or JPG).
settings.autoPrintReceipt: Auto print fee receipt after payment
settings.securityHint: These values are enforced in the main process and cannot be bypassed from the interface.
settings.userControlHint: Every account in the software. The administrator can change any user's username or set a new password.
settings.changeUsernameHint: Used at the next sign-in. 3-60 characters: letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores. Letters are converted to lowercase.
settings.changeUsernameWarning: The user must sign in with the new username from now on. Their password does not change.
settings.requirePasswordChange: Ask for a new password at the next login
settings.passwordPolicyHint: Choose whether the user has to replace this password after signing in.
settings.currentRecordsHint: What the school is holding right now
settings.dangerZoneHint: These actions delete records. They cannot be undone from the screen.
settings.clearDataHint: Removes every record of the running school - students, staff, attendance, marks, fees, salary, leaves, the timetable, the notices, the expenses and the audit log. The school profile, the settings, your administrator account and the academic structure (classes, sections, subjects) are kept, so the school is empty and ready to enrol again.
settings.factoryResetHint: Throws the whole database away and builds a new one with the factory demo state. Every account, including yours, is recreated. Use this to hand the computer over or to start completely clean.
settings.backupReminder: A safety backup is taken before anything is deleted, and the backups screen can restore it. Deleting the data ends your session - you will have to sign in again.
settings.clearWarning: Every record of this school is about to be deleted. There is no way back from this screen - only a backup can undo it.
settings.resetWarning: The entire database is about to be replaced. Your settings, your logo, every account and every record are destroyed, and the factory demo state is built again.
settings.signOutAgain: Your session ends after this, so you will have to sign in again.
